equity.level_reason: Groups compared are facility bed-size categories, not social-position groups; adults define the population served.

level_alternative.reason: The exclusion of communities serving persons with intellectual or developmental disability could be read as a disability descriptor, though it is a facility-type exclusion.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional from the national facility survey source; none named. Survey weighting is not stated, so not recorded. The outcome is facility offering of vaccination (a program measure), not individual uptake, so vaccine_outcome_type is other.
view_issues: The claim that percentages increased with bed size rests on side-by-side values with CI error bars; no test is stated.
